تتياسروا (form VI)
# تَتَيَاسَرُوا (tatayāsarū) /ta.ta.jaː.sa.ruː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of تَيَاسَرَ (tayāsara)
# تُتَيَاسَرُوا (tutayāsarū) /tu.ta.jaː.sa.ruː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of تَيَاسَرَ (tayāsara)
